cohort: The study included 29,807 eligible pregnant women who delivered in Lianyungang, Jiangsu Province, eastern China.
finding: Extreme maternal ages (≤18 or ≥35 years), a history of cesarean section, multiple previous births, hypertension, preeclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, placenta previa, or a history of PTB were associated with a higher risk of preterm birth, while five or more prenatal visits were associated with a lower risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with a higher risk of preterm birth (OR: 1.542, 95% CI: 1.360-1.748).
cross-section timing: Data was collected from deliveries between July 1, 2021, and June 30, 2022.
